system.notes: A biometric palm reader fitted to a weapon's grip and linked to its internal safety: unless the scanned palm matches the owner's, the safety stays locked and the weapon is inert. Compatible with most smartlink/smartgun technology. To change owners, burn new firmware onto an optical chip (blank chips 50¥, programmed at a computer repair shop or facility). Owners with a cyberhand use the IBS cyber modification instead. Legality is not printed in the catalog. Corporate Security Handbook p.71.
